title: Online Stage Setup
description: The one-time online commands that create the project, install pinned packages, pull the Ollama models, and cache the base model locally.

steps.description: Make the project folder, move into it, create a virtual environment, and activate it. The page calls this the online stage, run once with the network available.

Install the pinned packages: `chromadb`, `ollama`, `requests`, `pydantic-ai-slim`, `transformers`, `peft`, and `accelerate`. The last line installs the CPU build of `torch`, and the comment says to skip it on a GPU machine.

Pull three Ollama models with `ollama pull`. The comments name the embedding model `nomic-embed-text`, the generator `llama3.2`, and the tool-calling generator `qwen2.5:3b` for Section C, with each model's size and license.

Set `HF_HOME` so the Hugging Face cache stays inside the project, then download SmolLM2-360M-Instruct with `snapshot_download` at a pinned `revision`. The page says the revision is a commit hash, so a later update on the Hub cannot change what you trained on.
